info.title: hotel8-pos
info.description: Sentin8 H8POS - Point of Sale service.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Admin UI page id (overview | orders | payments | reports | settings | policy pages)

200.description: SDK AdminUiResponse envelope: { page: AdminPage (title + widgets: WidgetCard/WidgetDataTable/WidgetText with data_endpoint routes), status: "ok" } - see sentin8::rfw::page::AdminPage / sentin8::rfw::widget::RemoteWidget; policy pages reuse the shared Shield policy-studio definitions under the hotel8:pos domain

get.summary:
`GET /v1/guest/{property_id}/menu?outlet_id=` - menu catalog for the
room-service outlet (defaults to the property's first `ROOM_SERVICE`
outlet when `outlet_id` is omitted).

404.description: No room-service outlet for this property

post.summary:
`POST /v1/guest/{property_id}/orders` - room-service order. Creates an
`OPEN` check bound to the in-house reservation + room, inserts the ordered
lines (same machine the terminals use), returns the check + totals.

404.description: Reservation not in-house at this property

get.summary:
`GET /v1/guest/{property_id}/orders/{check_id}` - order status read-back
for the ordering screen (prep states drive the UI stepper).

200.description: In-house guest for the room (PMS projection fields)

404.description: No in-house guest found for this room
Reservation not found or guest not checked in

200.description: Created menu item (price/tax_rate as decimal strings)
Supported payment methods (all enabled by default)

404.description: Service area not found for this outlet
One or more tables not found

200.description: Floor plan (x/y are null - no position columns)

400.description: Cannot delete table with an open check
